summary.text: Jamie Jackson, a Democrat, has represented District 41 in the Colorado House of Representatives since 2025, after being appointed to the seat to replace Iman Jodeh.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Jackson is chief operating officer of The Naloxone Project and has served as vice president of Colorado Women for Political Action and as criminal justice chair of the Aurora chapter of the NAACP.
She earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of Colorado Boulder and a Master of Science in organizational leadership and HR management from Colorado State University Global.
